back: Crosscut (across grain), rip (along grain), bow saw (logs, pruning), hacksaw (metal).
Alternate teeth bent left and right so the cut is wider than the blade and it does not bind.
Always fit a handle; cut on the forward stroke; clean with a file card; never use as a lever (brittle).
Exact size; pull towards you; never hammer it or extend it with a pipe.
Tank, filter, pump and lever, pressure chamber, hose, trigger valve, lance, nozzle.
Triple rinse; spray rinse water on treated crop; clean nozzle with soft brush (never blow); store dry and locked.
Hoe, spade, shovel, digging fork, rake, pick, mattock, slasher.
Clean, dry, oil metal, sharpen edges, repair handles, store hung up under cover.
Blade pointing down; never leave rakes or forks with points upward.
